Slaking

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Slaking is a Normal-type Lazy Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 130.5 kg. It evolves from Vigoroth. Its highest base stat is Attack (160), with a base stat total of 670.
